boxed_error_drop.abi: Frozen Rust drop glue and dynamically selected destructor/deallocator ABI for Box<bincode::error::ErrorKind>.
boxed_error_drop.exceptional: Retain destructor panic/abort and allocation/deallocation failure semantics. Drop cannot turn rejected input into accepted execution.
boxed_error_drop.normal: Drop each initialized payload exactly once and deallocate using the original allocator/layout; preserve destructor order and all library/allocator post-state.
boxed_error_drop.oracle: Reachable error payload destructors/deallocators issue no spend-oracle query, checkpoint/account mutation or authority change. A payload failing confinement remains an owned callback obligation.
boxed_error_drop.precondition: The Box and any nested error trait object have valid allocator and vtable provenance from the frozen reachable library path; no serialized input is treated as a vtable pointer.
boxed_error_drop.scope: Only the listed Box<bincode::error::ErrorKind> drop callx. No other destructor is silently trusted.

fmt_dispatch.abi: Frozen Rust core::fmt ABI and vtable layout at the pinned callx; data and metadata must originate from the same constructed trait object or fmt::Arguments entry.
fmt_dispatch.exceptional: Retain allocator failure, nested callback failure and panic/abort behavior. Formatting failure or panic never fabricates an accepted verification result.
fmt_dispatch.normal: Invoke exactly the method selected by that object/argument, in the original call order with the original receiver, Formatter options, width/precision, and input string/character/value. Preserve every formatting write and mutable formatter/sink field, the returned fmt::Result, and short circuit on its actual Err.
fmt_dispatch.oracle: Every reachable concrete formatting callback is confined to formatting/sink state and issues no spend-oracle read, checkpoint mutation, account write or authority change. If this confinement cannot be adopted for a callback, expose its effects as an owned site instead.
fmt_dispatch.precondition: The reachable Rust formatting object is live, correctly aligned and initialized; its concrete callback has the exact method ABI. The compiler preserves this provenance; the attacker cannot inject a raw callback address through serialized spend bytes.
fmt_dispatch.scope: Only the listed core::fmt/core::panic::panic_info callx instructions. No owned digest callback, allocation helper, verifier arithmetic, account adapter or general arbitrary Rust trait object is covered.
